first_order_optimizer_aggregate.description: Table 1 style comparison of first-order solvers for tabular imperfect-recall decision problems. Every solver is run by the evaluator from 12 fixed random starts per problem with a 6000-iteration budget (one gradient evaluation per iteration) and the KKT-gap threshold 1e-6; utility, gap and iterations are computed by the evaluator. Each row is compared against a frozen field of the paper's comparators (GD, OGD, AMSGrad with per-problem best settings, RM, RM+, PRM, PRM+). Train: the paper's 20 public small/medium instances with the authors' own logged runs as the field. Test: 24 hidden instances drawn with the paper's generators at the same size presets.
first_order_optimizer_aggregate._scale_note: The paper's numbers below are its Table 1 aggregates over 61 instances up to tens of millions of nodes, ranked among 8 algorithms (incl. Gurobi), with wall-clock time as the convergence measure. The gym uses the paper's small/medium size presets (86 to 43k nodes), ranks among the 7 first-order algorithms, measures convergence in gradient evaluations, and counts a run's utility only if the run reaches the KKT threshold. The paper's numbers are kept for orientation; the gym does not try to match them.

value_percent_best.description: Percent of problems where the median run's utility (runs that miss the KKT threshold count as worst) is within 1e-4 (relative) of the best median utility among the frozen comparators.

value_avg_rank.description: Average tie-aware rank of the median run's utility among the frozen comparators plus the scored solver (1 = best).

utility_gain_mean.description: Mean over problems and starts of the utility gained over the uniform strategy, as a fraction of the best gain known from the frozen comparators' runs (runs that miss the KKT threshold score 0; values above 1 beat every comparator run).

convergence_percent_reached.description: Percent of problems where the median run ends on a strategy with KKT gap <= 1e-6 within the 6000-iteration budget.

convergence_percent_best.description: Percent of problems where the median run reaches the KKT threshold in no more iterations than any frozen comparator's median run.

convergence_avg_rank.description: Average tie-aware rank of the median run's iterations to the KKT threshold among the frozen comparators plus the scored solver (runs that miss the threshold count as budget + 1).

log10_iterations_mean.description: Mean over problems and starts of log10 of the gradient evaluations used to reach the KKT threshold (budget + 1 = 6001 for runs that miss it).

restart_convergence_percent.description: Percent of all (problem, start) runs that end on a strategy with KKT gap <= 1e-6.
